FOUNDER STOCK PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Founder Stock Purchase Agreement is between Fennel Robotics, Inc. (the "Company") and Mira Castellan (the "Founder").

1. Purchase. Founder purchases 4,000,000 shares of common stock at $0.0001 per share.

2. Vesting. The shares vest over four years with a one-year cliff. The Company may repurchase unvested shares at cost if Founder stops providing services.

3. Section 83(b). Founder understands that an election under Section 83(b) must be filed within 30 days after the purchase.

4. Transfer. Founder may not transfer unvested shares.
